_comment: Single source for tagline, skills and jobs. Run `python3 build.py` to regenerate the marked regions in the .tex files. Plain text only: build.py escapes & % $ # _ for LaTeX. Skill items and bullets take an optional "in": ["compact"|"full"] to limit them to one variant. A bullet's "compact" key overrides its text in the compact variant.
tagline: Tech Lead with 15+ years building CI/CD platforms and cloud infrastructure. Led platform teams that cut AWS spend by about 40% and reduced full-environment deploys from an hour to minutes. Now building safe, cost-controlled AI-assisted engineering workflows.

bullets.text: Led a globally distributed team of 12 DevOps engineers providing CI/CD, infrastructure, and platform services to 500+ software engineers, standardizing metadata-driven and GitOps deployment practices across the software development lifecycle.
bullets.compact: Led globally distributed team of 12 engineers supporting 500+ developers; standardized metadata-driven and GitOps deployment practices.

bullets.text: Cut AWS spend from $500K+ to $300K per month through Cloudability cost visibility, cost controls, and compute, storage, and I/O optimization.
Designed and implemented metadata management using CueLang to drive consistent, metadata-driven deployments.

Led migration of 150+ services, 150+ Angular apps, and associated databases and servers from on-premises RHEV to AWS EKS using Terraform for resource provisioning, supporting the monolith to microservices transition; owned IAM policy design.
Reduced full-environment deploy time from 1 hour to minutes; optimized Gradle plugins to cut build times and moved deployments from Gradle-based to artifact-based.
Automated disaster recovery and failover for Jenkins CI/CD infrastructure, reducing recovery from 4 hours of manual process to 1 hour.
bullets.compact: Automated disaster recovery and failover, reducing recovery from 4 hours of manual process to 1 hour.

bullets.text: Designed and rolled out custom GitFlow with automated enforcement and a rollback strategy, cutting MTTR from hours to minutes; added safeguards and monitoring that reduced incidents by 50%. Established standards for pipeline code, IaC, and automation.
bullets.compact: Designed custom GitFlow with automated enforcement and a rollback strategy, cutting MTTR from hours to minutes; added safeguards and monitoring that reduced incidents by 50%.

bullets.compact: Drove post-acquisition integration of SquareTrade CI/CD into Allstate; rewrote shared pipeline libraries.
